rows: Reach is low despite good content
Understand platform algorithm: what does it reward? Reformat accordingly
Message is going viral but not persuading
Viral != persuasive. Are you reaching the converted or the persuadable?
Publish with full context; provide canonical source; thread for Toulmin structure
Build provenance (institutional affiliation, verification, track record)
Need to cross ideological cluster lines
Find bridge frames; appear in unexpected venue; acknowledge opponent's legitimate concerns
Wrap technical content in personal story; front-load with question; post when network is active
Lead with the truth (not "the claim is false"); short, memorable correction; note why false but don't repeat the false claim
